transcript: あれ？もう一年経ったの？全然気が付かなかった。指揮官がそばにいて、気が緩みすぎちゃったからかな。
english: Huh? It’s been a year already? I didn’t even notice. Maybe I let my guard down a little too much with you by my side, Commander.

transcript: もうまったく、一周年だとか言ってさ、指揮官はいつまでたっても二分ちんだよね。私たちが家族として過ごした時間は、一年なんてもんじゃないでしょ?
english: Jeez. You keep going on about a one-year anniversary, but you’re as dense as ever, Commander. The time we’ve spent as a family is way more than a year, right?

transcript: よーし、一年間頑張ったんだもん、今日くらい休んでも平気だよね。えへへ、指揮官も面倒事は一旦置いて、一緒にパーティーを楽しもうよ。
english: Alright! We’ve worked hard all year—taking today off is fine, right? Hehe. Commander, put the hassles aside for now and let’s enjoy the party together.

transcript: ハッピーバースデー！って、どうしたのそんな顔して。家族の誕生日なんだから、祝うのは当たり前じゃない。
english: Happy birthday! What’s with that face? It’s family—of course we celebrate.

transcript: 指揮官、はいプレゼント。素敵でしょ?リバレート一緒に選んだんだ。誕生日おめでとう。
english: Commander, here—your present. Nice, right? Liberate and I picked it out. Happy birthday.

transcript: 指揮官、ハッピーバースデー!まさか私が出てくるなんて思いもしなかったでしょ?なんたってサプライズだもん。任務?心配しないで、ちゃんと終わらせてきたから。
english: Commander, happy birthday! Bet you never thought I’d show up, huh? It’s a surprise, after all. Mission? Don’t worry—I got it done.

transcript: ハッピーバースデー！え、忘れるわけないよ。だって指揮官は私の…やっぱりナイショ。早くプレゼント開けてみて！
english: Happy birthday! What? Like I’d ever forget. Because, Commander, you’re my… actually, that’s a secret. Hurry up and open your present!

transcript: 今日はエルマ号で超超超豪華なパーティーがあるんだけど、主役は誰だと思う?そう、指揮官のために私たちみんなで準備したんだよ。私からのサプライズも用意してるから楽しみにしててね、指揮官。
english: We’re throwing a super, super, super fancy party aboard the Elma today—guess who the guest of honor is? That’s right, we all set it up for you, Commander. I’ve got a little surprise of my own, so look forward to it, Commander.

transcript: あ、指揮官！このお菓子あげるね。すっごく美味しいんだよ。なんたって見た目が可愛いし……えへへ。ん？もしかして食べさせてほしいの？いいよ。ほら、お口を開けて。あーん♪
english: Oh, Commander! Here, have this treat. It’s super tasty—plus it looks adorable... hehe. Hm? Do you want me to feed you? Sure. Come on, open wide. Say ahh~

transcript: よし、次にこれを詰め込んでっと…あ、指揮官!えへへ、私の作ったクラッカーなんだ。ペプリンが教えてくれたの。指揮官も一緒に作る?一緒にならせば、より記念日っぽくなるよ。
english: Alright, next this goes in... Ah, Commander! Hehe, I made these party poppers. Peprin taught me. Want to make some together? If we pop them together, it’ll feel more like an anniversary.

transcript: メリークリスマス。指揮官へのプレゼントはちゃんと用意してあるよ。プレゼントに合いそうなものを見つけるとね、つい我慢できず買っちゃうんだー。
english: Merry Christmas. Your present’s all ready, Commander. Whenever I spot something that would go with it, I just can’t help picking it up too.

transcript: 指揮官はドラゴンボートって知ってる?龍をかたどってるみたいなんだけど、ああいうドラゴンもいるもんなんだね。私てっきり、ドラゴンってみんな大きな翼があるものだと思ってたよ
english: Commander, ever heard of dragon boats? They’re shaped like dragons—I didn’t know there were dragons like that. I always thought they all had big wings.

transcript: さすが指揮官!全然足音変わってないね。
english: That's our Commander! Your footsteps haven't changed a bit.

transcript: 前と違う?うーん、まあ一応成長してはいるからね。色々と。
english: Huh... so I look different? Hm... I guess I've grown in more ways than one.

transcript: 指揮官、ここではレナって呼んでくれないと。そうそう、リヴァネーに言われてこの名前にしたんだよ。気に入ってるんだ。
english: Commander, you need to call me Lenna around here. Oh, right—Big Sis Leva told me to go with this name. I like it.

transcript: あ、さっき指揮官のこと考えてたんだ。家族を気にかけるのは当然でしょ?
english: Ah... I was just thinking about you, Commander. Hehe♪ It's only natural to think about your family, right?

transcript: 司令官、私の育てたゼラニウムがついに咲いたんだ！今度こそ枯らさないぞ！
english: Hehe♪ Commander, the geraniums I was raising bloomed at last! I won't let them wither this time!

transcript: ちょっと、指揮官、何するの、私たちまだそんな関係じゃないでしょ。まあ、家族ではあるけど、だ、ダメったらダメ!
english: Hey, Commander, what do you think you’re doing? We’re not like that yet! I mean, we are family, but n-no means no!

transcript: あら、指揮官?どうやら鼻筋のケアが必要みたいね。どう?びっくりした?似てるでしょ。
english: Oh? You'd better mind your nose, Commander— Pfhahaha, did I scare you? Looks like I managed to imitate her well♪

transcript: そんなに私の目を見ないでよ。素体を変えたからもう傷はないんだって。やっぱりもう一度刻んだ方がいいかな。指揮官はどう思う?
english: Quit staring into my eyes. I swapped bodies, so the scars are gone. Should I carve them back in? What do you think, Commander?

transcript: 指揮官、今まで本当にありがとう……これは感謝のチューだよ。あはは……本気にした?指揮官のその目、前と同じだ。
english: Commander, thank you for taking care of me all this time. Here's a smooch of gratitude for you— Hahaha, did you think I really meant that? That look in your eyes is just like before♪

english: Hm? Commander, look, over there! ...(smch)♪ Hehe, I meant that this time. Didn't expect that, huh?

english: Hehe♪ I bet the Commander will be super scared if I pop out now. Ah, I want to see the look of surprise on the Commander's aiiiiieeeee?! Commander, when did you... what are you doing here?!

transcript: えっとさ、指揮官、変化って悪いことじゃないよね。うん、本当にみんなすごくなった。リバネもそうだし、指揮官だってそう。こりゃ私も頑張らなきゃだね。
english: Uh, Commander, change isn’t a bad thing, right? Yeah, everyone’s really gotten better—Big Sis Leva too, and you as well. Guess I’ve gotta step up, too.

english: Mmm... Commander, I think you might look great in punk fashion! Want to give it a try? I know a place that specializes in it, want to go there with me next time?

transcript: 家族と見るお月様って、一層綺麗に見えるね。柔らかくて明るくて、私もお月様みたいな人になりたいな。
english: The moon looks even more beautiful when I watch it with my family. It’s so gentle and bright—I wish I could be like the moon, too.

transcript: 中秋節といえば、家族みんなが集まる日。今日はリバ姉、カリン姉、それから404のみんなを呼んでお月見する予定だから、指揮官も絶対来てね!
english: The Mid-Autumn Festival’s when the whole family gets together. I’m having a moon-viewing tonight with Big Sis Leva, Big Sis Kalina, and everyone from 404—so make sure you come too, Commander!

english: A wish, huh... I’m already plenty happy, but... Ah! I know! I wish I could spend more time with everyone and the Commander!

english: Commander, have you decided how you’ll spend New Year’s? A shrine visit? The festival? Or shopping? Do whatever you like, but you’ve gotta be with family!

transcript: 指揮官指揮官、今夜幽霊の格好しようと思うんだ。え?そういう日じゃない?ハロウィンとあまり変わらない日だと思ってたんだけど、違ったんだね。
english: Commander, Commander, I’m thinking of dressing up as a ghost tonight. Huh? Not that kind of day? I figured it was close enough to Halloween. Guess not.

english: Surprised? I dressed up like a lion. Cute, right? I’m doing the lion dance with Pepry today, so look forward to it!

english: Commander, today’s, well... the day you tell me how you feel, right? So I’m looking forward to it. No more playing dumb.
